credibility.line: Management delivers on general business growth but misses specific capital raising timelines like subordinated debt.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Profit after tax grew 16.5% YoY to Rs 522 crore in Sep 2026, aligning with management claims of solid H1 performance.
Borrowings remained flat at Rs 3,099 crore in Sep 2026, contradicting the expected Q2 completion of the Rs 500 crore sub-debt raise.

bull: PAT grew 16.5% YoY to Rs 522 crore in Sep 2026.
Strong 5-year operating cash conversion at 773% of profit.
Solvency ratio remained robust at 180% as of September 30, 2026.
bear: Borrowings increased 3.3x over 3 years from Rs 950 crore in Mar 2024 to Rs 3,099 crore in Sep 2026.
EBITDA margins remain thin, hovering around 1.4% to 1.5% through FY27 quarters.
Subordinated debt raising guided for Q2 FY27 was not reflected in the reported borrowings.
watch: Completion of the Rs 500 crore subordinated debt raise.
